visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a man with bleached blonde hair wearing glasses and a maroon sweater with a teddy bear icon standing beside a woman with long dark hair in a mustard yellow top. They are indoors in a well-lit hallway with white wooden panels and warm ceiling lights. (2) The man positions the woman's forehead against the wall and holds a paper banknote above her head, explaining the rules of the game. He releases the note, and she attempts to catch it with her forehead but fails, looking down while the camera zooms in slightly on the falling note. (3) The camera cuts to the man's turn where the woman holds several banknotes against the white wall. He leans his head forward and successfully traps a stack of bills against the wall, reacting with a wide mouth and raised hands in celebration while the woman laughs and points at him. (4) A young girl with dark hair wearing a white long-sleeved shirt with a bunny graphic and orange pants enters the frame to collect the money from the floor. A second man in a grey patterned pajama shirt squats down to help her while other guests are visible in a background dining area with food. (5) The man in the maroon sweater guides the child to try the game, holding her head gently toward the wall with his hands. She fails two consecutive attempts, smiling shyly at the camera while the adults encourage her with broad hand gestures and supportive smiles in a wide shot. (6) The second man in grey pajamas attempts the challenge under bright indoor lighting. He strikes the wall with his forehead as the money is dropped, catching it successfully and leaning back with an exaggerated proud expression while the man in maroon sweater claps his hands near his face. (7) In the final sequence, the woman in green tries again with the man in the grey shirt, but he playfully pulls her head or blocks her as she misses the notes. The scene is chaotic with fast cuts and various variety-show text overlays appearing as they all laugh and move around.
